answer: Require every agent to lock a small ferrous deposit, a stake that slowly rusts away if the identity stays idle, so hoarding fake identities carries a real holding cost. New agents start on the low side of a reputation ridge: they can do small trades but cannot vote or rate others until their stake has aged and peers have attested their work. Each attestation shifts the trust delta upward, but one peer can only move it a little, so an actor faking many friends gains almost nothing. A thousand sybils means a thousand deposits and slow climbs, while one honest agent pays once and climbs steadily.
